description: Source code implementing a WGL (Windows OpenGL) surface for DXGI swap chain integration in ANGLE, handling swap chain creation, buffer management, and texture binding for Windows graphics rendering.

classes.name: DXGISwapChainWindowSurfaceWGL
classes.description: Class implementing a Windows-specific surface for rendering with DXGI swap chain and WGL, managing buffers, swap chain creation, and texture binding.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface, creates swap chain, and sets up buffers based on window size.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Presents the swap chain buffers to display rendered content.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Presents a sub-region of the buffer, supporting partial updates.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds the swap chain buffer as a texture for rendering.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the texture binding to the swap chain buffer.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for buffer swapping.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates the DXGI swap chain for the window, handling different factory versions.

methods.name: checkForResize
methods.description: Checks if the window size has changed and recreates the swap chain if needed.

methods.name: setObjectsLocked
methods.description: Locks or unlocks D3D objects for shared access.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates a default framebuffer object for rendering.
